title: Shedeur Sanders or Deshaun Watson? Browns' Todd Monken still undecided at QB

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Shedeur Sanders or Deshaun Watson? Browns' Todd Monken still undecided at QB
sources.description: Todd Monken still isn't ready to choose a winner in the Shedeur Sanders vs. Deshaun Watson competition. "I just can't do it," the Browns coach said.
